column1: # NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition (Global / US 1.0.1 v0 and 1.0.3 v131072), PlatinumGames / NVN, SDK 12.3.9.
# Tested 2026-11-08 through 2026-11-10: movies, title, menus and save-loaded Desert Zone.
# CPU-filled colour LUT upload and geometry storage bindings restore title/map materials.
# Once-only GS buffer effects recover missing triangles on Adreno; short movement/camera tested.
# Rebased build tested 2026-11-15 on Xiaomi Pad 7: user reports gameplay working; no Vulkan VUIDs in the collected log.
# Tested 2026-11-25 on Retroid Pocket 6 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, Adreno 740, Mesa Turnip v27.0.0-R2):
# - Base 1.0.1 (v0) registered alongside optional update 1.0.3 (v131072); both builds carry verified 60 fps + 1.0f dynamic-resolution floor cuts in patches.py.
# - Update 1.0.3 (v131072): movies, title (60 fps), save loading/committing (6 atomic save commits), City Ruins, Desert cave, and DLC mounting (aoc/1/data500.cpk) verified.
# - Base 1.0.1 (v0): boot to title at 60 fps verified on device.
# Full-game completion and long-session stability are unverified. See docs/NIER_AUTOMATA_ANDROID_PORT.md.
